notes.title: Patch 1.3 - Collider improvement
notes.content:
We would like to report some improvements that were made in version 1.3:
[olist]
 We improved the game's collider system, now it's easier to choose tiles that are partially hidden by some piece
 Fixed lighting bug
[/olist]

notes.title: Chess Dungeons is officially launched
notes.content:
Chess Dungeons is officially launched
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42473881/24b545dbc923fa531949dd2923c2fda60b4325dc.png

Help the white pieces escape by solving chess puzzles ranging from beginner-level to more experienced challenges in this dungeon-themed sokoban-style game.
With two game modes:

 Your goal is to slay the enemy's King. While other pieces can (and sometimes should!) be targeted, your main focus is to eliminate the King.
 A harder challenge! Don't just target the enemy King. Wipe out all of the black pieces!


I would like to thank the entire community, the playtesters without you the game would not be possible.
